title: Open reference cup (spec Section 17): 3-D printed circumaural cup around the Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32
description: The validation artefact of spec Section 17 (validation/reference_cup/, docs/reference-cup.md). A rigid printed cup: the driver sealed in a baffle, a front cavity closed by a rigid pad ring with a closed-cell sponge gasket, two front ports and one rear port that take swappable plugs (sealed, open hole, hole covered by SAATI Acoustex 260), and a rear chamber of known volume. Both cavities are modal cylinders at level 1: in a cup this wide the pressure at the ear port is not the cavity's mean pressure above about 2 kHz, and a depth-line cavity misses the notch the radial field puts near 5 kHz. Loads: IEC 60318-4 on a flat plate (undamped, and the damped variant through the undamped model: the engine cannot represent the damping), ITU-T P.57 Type 4.3 on a head and torso simulator, the cup in free air (front open), the bare driver in free air. Geometry comes from validation/reference_cup/dimensions.json; driver values are the datasheet's primary set (erratum E5). Tolerances name their source; estimates say so. Not modelled: the driver's internal rear vents, damping and rear volume (not on the datasheet), the free-air air load folded into the datasheet's Mms, pad compression dynamics, wall vibration, the pinna's acoustics on the head and torso simulator, and orifice nonlinearity of the open hole.

SAATI technical data sheet (2019) gives 260 MKS rayl without a tolerance; 10-15 % is industry practice (spec Section 13). All discs are cut from one sheet, so one value serves every port.

residual_leak_gap_mm.label: Residual leak under the gasket (0 = none)

tolerance.source: estimate: the protocol sets the nominal per fixture (flat plate 0.01 mm, head and torso simulator 0.05 mm); fitted in the acceptance test

residual_leak_gap_mm.description: Mean gap of a slit around the gasket's contact band; the leak the acceptance test fits. At level 1 keep it at 0 or above 0.005 mm: below about 4 um the distributed slit's transfer matrix is too ill-conditioned for the solver above 20 kHz (a 1 um gap already fails at 1.6 kHz).

pinna_volume_cm3.label: Volume taken by the pinna and head inside the cup

tolerance.source: estimate: 0 on a flat plate; the protocol sets 10 cm3 on the head and torso simulator

front_volume_factor.label: Front volume factor
front_volume_factor.description: Scales the front cavity (its depth, at the cup's diameter). Fitted in the acceptance test; 1 is the design.

iec_entrance_radius_mm.label: IEC 60318-4 entrance radius
iec_entrance_radius_mm.description: R0 of the engine's IEC 60318-4 model (Luan et al. 2019, Table 1; data/ear/iec60318_4.json): the ear port on the flat plate.

eep_area_mm2.label: Type 4.3 ear entrance area
eep_area_mm2.description: Cross-section at the EEP of the engine's Type 4.3 geometry (docs/ear-loads.md): the ear port on the head and torso simulator. The pinna is not modelled.

source_impedance_ohm.label: Amplifier output impedance
source_impedance_ohm.description: The protocol asks for below 1 ohm and a stated value in every sidecar.

drive_mW.label: Drive power into the rated impedance
drive_mW.description: The protocol's drive: 10 uW into 32 ohm (17.9 mV RMS), which keeps the meshed and sealed configurations far below the 1 m/s particle-velocity limit. At 1 mW the open rear hole reaches 1.5 m/s on the fixture.

recess_volume_cm3.label: Volume in front of the diaphragm inside the lip

front_port_z_mm.expr: clamp(front_depth_mm - gasket_compressed_mm - pad_ring_height_mm / 2, front_hole_diameter_mm / 2, front_depth_mm - front_hole_diameter_mm / 2)
front_port_z_mm.label: Front ports: height above the driver face

rear_volume_cm3.expr: (pi * cup_radius_mm^2 * rear_depth_mm - pi * ((retainer_outer_diameter_mm / 2)^2 - (retainer_inner_diameter_mm / 2)^2) * retainer_thickness_mm - pi * (driver_rear_boss_diameter_mm / 2)^2 * (driver_overall_depth_mm - driver_body_depth_mm)) / 1000
rear_volume_cm3.label: Rear chamber volume

ear_port_radius_mm.expr: if(load == 'type43', sqrt(eep_area_mm2 / pi), if(load == 'cup_free_air', cup_radius_mm, iec_entrance_radius_mm))
